name: Jacopo Bearzatti
original_name: ヤコポ・ベアルザッティ
source:
From year: 1869

A businessman who has invested in the budding rail industry.

Ruthless and proud, Jacopo will readily toss aside anything and take advantage of anyone in order to further his own ambitions.

Having clawed his way to the top in a world where the language is deceit and manipulation, Jacopo cannot even trust his own wife. There are only two things in life he can believe in: money and power.

Just where will the rail industry—in which he has staked his entire livelihood—take him?

"How many times are you gonna make me repeat myself, you worthless tramp? Are those ears only for show?"

[From the [url=http://mangagamer.org/fatamorgana/]English official site[/url]]

[spoiler]In [url=/v18397]Fata morgana no Yakata -Another Episodes-[/url]:

A sharp-tongued and somewhat difficult young man.

Jacopo won’t stand for injustice, and he’s particularly displeased with the lord’s iron-fisted rule. He once assisted in a slave revolt at the lord’s estate.

Never could he imagine the misfortune that awaits at the end of his path.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1053/]MangaGamer[/url]][/spoiler]
